#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-9;

struct Vec {
    double x, y;
    
    Vec(double x = 0, double y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {}
    
    Vec add(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y); }
    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y); }
    Vec scale(double s) const { return Vec(x * s, y * s); }
    double dot(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y; }
    double cross(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.y - y * o.x; }
    double mag2() const { return dot(*this); }
    double mag() const { return sqrt(mag2()); }
    Vec unit() const { return scale(1 / mag()); }
    Vec rot90() const { return Vec(-y, x); }
    Vec rot270() const { return Vec(y, -x); }
    
    Vec rotate(double theta) const {
        double newX = x * cos(theta) + y * cos(theta + M_PI / 2);
        double newY = x * sin(theta) + y * sin(theta + M_PI / 2);
        return Vec(newX, newY);
    }
    
    double angle() const {
        return fmod(atan2(y, x) + 2 * M_PI, 2 * M_PI);
    }
    
    string toString() const {
        ostringstream oss;
        oss << fixed << setprecision(2) << "(" << x << ", " << y << ")";
        return oss.str();
    }
    
    static bool eq(double a, double b) { return fabs(a - b) < EPS; }
    static bool leq(double a, double b) { return a - EPS < b; }
    static bool geq(double a, double b) { return a + EPS > b; }
    
    bool equals(const Vec& o) const {
        return eq(x, o.x) && eq(y, o.y);
    }
    
    bool operator==(const Vec& other) const {
        return equals(other);
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Vec c;
    double r;
    
    Circle(const Vec& c, double r) : c(c), r(r) {}
    
    bool contains(const Vec& v) const {
        return c.sub(v).mag2() - EPS * EPS <= r * r;
    }
    
    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& o) const {
        if (c.equals(o.c)) return {};
        Vec dir = o.c.sub(c);
        double d2 = dir.mag2();
        double d = sqrt(d2);
        
        if (r + o.r < d - EPS || r + d < o.r - EPS || o.r + d < r - EPS)
            return {};
        
        if (Vec::eq(r + o.r, d) || Vec::eq(o.r + d, r)) {
            return {c.add(dir.scale(r / d))};
        }
        if (Vec::eq(r + d, o.r)) {
            return {c.sub(dir.scale(r / d))};
        }
        
        double d1 = (r * r + d2 - o.r * o.r) / (2 * d);
        double h = sqrt(max(0.0, r * r - d1 * d1));
        Vec unitDir = dir.unit();
        Vec rInt = c.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot270().scale(h)));
        Vec lInt = c.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot90().scale(h)));
        return {rInt, lInt};
    }
};

class UnionFind {
public:
    vector<int> parent;
    
    UnionFind(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }
    
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }
    
    void unite(int x, int y) {
        int px = find(x);
        int py = find(y);
        if (px != py) {
            parent[px] = py;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    vector<Circle> circ(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circ[i] = Circle(Vec(x, y), r);
    }
    
    vector<Vec> points;
    UnionFind uf(n);
    int res = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<Vec> points2;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> intersections = circ[i].intersect(circ[j]);
            if (intersections.empty()) continue;
            
            int a = uf.find(i);
            int b = uf.find(j);
            uf.unite(a, b);
            
            for (const Vec& e : intersections) {
                bool found = false;
                for (const Vec& e2 : points2) {
                    if (e.equals(e2)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!found) {
                    points2.push_back(e);
                }
            }
        }
        res += points2.size();
        
        for (const Vec& e : points2) {
            bool found = false;
            for (const Vec& e2 : points) {
                if (e.equals(e2)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) {
                points.push_back(e);
            }
        }
    }
    
    res -= points.size();
    
    int components = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (uf.find(i) == i) {
            components++;
        }
    }
    res += components;
    
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
